weaknesses.rootCause: Counter-based character multisets lost order and insertion position; accepted/refused Undo outcomes were not fully identified.
weaknesses.correction: Exact Unicode text at the observed caret, selection, synchronized revisions, transaction state and Undo/Redo depths. Trusted native Ctrl+Z/final insertion and complete ordered command trace distinguish accepted-after-commit from refused-then-committed. Subsequent typing checks exact anchor and caret.

weaknesses.rootCause: Recorded origin, runtime flags, Release metadata and oracle generation were not all mandatory verdict predicates; empty all() and missing format/scenario evidence could pass.
weaknesses.correction: Enforce expected executable and running process SHA, exact embedded origin, build-time flag manifest plus JS/CSS bytes and entrypoints, absent hooks/traces, approved full Release metadata/artifact hashes and hash-verified independent oracle; both formats, mandatory named checks and eight exact saved-file oracles per format required.

weaknesses.rootCause: Global diagnostic teardown records were not enforced as complete, successful evidence belonging to each current session; parent cleanup had not happened when a child could report PASS.
weaknesses.correction: Bind run/session/process ownership to existing cleanup records; reject missing/extra/mismatched/incomplete/error records, unsuccessful DELETE, driver kill/nonzero or boolean exit, fallback cleanup or survivors. Parent cleanup includes run/command identity and raw ownership/survivor observations before final PASS.

syntheticValidatorTests.positiveCases: Exact insertion, both explicitly permitted composition Undo outcomes, complete production/usability rows, owned inner/outer cleanup; no parent -> INCONCLUSIVE, matching pending parent -> PENDING_CLEANUP.
